en: Lately, Ayano has been flipping through the calendar and checking the weather forecast.
Although she hasn't told me where we're going, I'm really looking forward to it.
“I feel like you've snuck up on me a million times!”
“That's because you're too focused on this date.”
Have you decided on the day?
Aren't you going to tell me?
“It's more fun keeping it a surprise.”
Kay, I'm looking forward to it, Ayano.
